messages:
maria-marketing: Quick alignment for the release post: need final changelog URL + canonical docs link, hero bench line, and confirmation of the canary window (APAC first, then global ~2h later).

sam-eng: Changelog (stable): https://docs.redwood.inference/release/2026-03-23-changelog. Canonical docs: https://docs.redwood.inference/launch/2026-03-optimize. Canary plan: start 11:00 PDT in APAC, initial 5%, promote after 2h if metrics OK.

maria-marketing: Can you drop the exact YAML so support can mirror it in the playbook and we can paste in the blog?

sam-eng: Paste: ```
rollout:
  canary:
    start: "2026-03-23T11:00:00-07:00"
    regions: ["apac"]
    initial_pct: 5
    step_pct: 10
    promote_after: 2h
  global_promote: "2026-03-23T13:00:00-07:00"
```

ellie-product: For the hero: "95th pctl latency @256 tokens (GPU A100, int8): 42ms — ~3.1x cost reduction vs fp16." I can draft a 2-paragraph bench note calling out batching/kv cache.

maria-marketing: That works. Nate, want the webinar to demo traffic ramp ~90m after global promote?

nate-growth: Yes — scheduling at 14:30 PDT. I'll wire registration, embed, and drip. Will post iframe snippet in this thread once ready.

maria-marketing: Routing: enterprise leads must reach AE queue immediately. Jon, is the webhook ready to tag and route by company size?

jon-sre: Webhook is ready. On changelog publish deploy-bot will POST to /support/lead-route and tag "enterprise" when company_size > 200. Example payload I added to the playbook: {"lead":"ACME Corp","tier":"enterprise","source":"launch_post_2026-03-23"}.

sam-eng: FYI — if marketing wants to shorten the promote window we need notice by 09:30 PDT so SRE can adjust autoscale thresholds.

maria-marketing: Noted. Final checklist before publish: changelog link (sam) ✅ docs link (sam) ✅ hero bench (ellie) ✅ webhook/playbook (jon) ✅ webinar embed & reg (nate) ✅ speakers list (maria by EOD).

deploy-bot: Scheduled publish hook set for 2026-03-23T10:00:00-07:00. If any assets change after 09:30 PDT, ping #release-war-room.

maria-marketing: Great — I'll post the final blog draft here for a quick read before the automated publish. :rocket:
